result:
The README describes **item-tracker**, a small item-tracking service built incrementally across working sessions. It notes that working conventions are agreed with the project owner in session — including append-only storage, tombstone-based deletion (records are never hard-deleted), typed API error codes, and UTC ISO-8601 timestamps — and that the authoritative set of decisions lives wherever the project's sessions record them. Tests run with `python -m pytest`.

(For what it's worth, my session memory does hold those recorded decisions: ULID IDs, append-only JSONL, typed error codes, UTC-Z timestamps, tombstone deletion, 90-day retention, `/v1` prefix, and a 50-items-per-user limit.)
